headline: Consistent at the core, frayed at the edges
lede: Almost everything goes through the project's tokens (a named value defined once). What stands out is a handful of buttons styled by hand on the dashboard and order screens, and a toolbar whose corners disagree.

color.summary: The brand green exists as a token, yet the legacy checkbox types the value by hand; grays mix the project's neutral tokens with the Tailwind palette. The soft brand colour has no dark value.

typography.no_change_reason: no size is typed by hand

spacing.summary: Spacing follows the grid, except one hand-typed padding.

radius.summary: Corners use tokens, but two rows put buttons with different radii side by side.

shadow.summary: Shadows all come from the scale.
shadow.no_change_reason: no shadow is typed by hand

components.summary: Buttons exist in three implementations, with a few one-off buttons styled by hand next to the base one. An old checkbox implementation is still around.

F:SIB-RADIUS:2171e7.title: The toolbar mixes corner radii
F:SIB-RADIUS:2171e7.explanation: The filter and sort buttons sit in one row with the refresh button, which is squarer.
F:SIB-RADIUS:2171e7.cause: the refresh button was written by hand instead of using the base button

F:SIB-RADIUS:0f045f.title: The settings form's input and button corners differ
F:SIB-RADIUS:0f045f.explanation: An input and the save button of the same height sit side by side with different rounding.
F:SIB-RADIUS:0f045f.cause: input and button use different radius tokens

F:SIG-SPRAWL:41d379.title: Several buttons are styled by hand
F:SIG-SPRAWL:41d379.explanation: Although a base button exists, the dashboard, order and settings screens have buttons with their own classes.
F:SIG-SPRAWL:41d379.cause: each generation made a new button

F:DUP-IMPL:41d379.title: Buttons have several implementations
F:DUP-IMPL:41d379.explanation: Besides the base Button, raw button tags and a DynamicButton act as buttons.

F:DUP-IMPL:0be687.title: Two checkbox implementations
F:DUP-IMPL:0be687.explanation: The settings form uses the shadcn checkbox while a LegacyCheckbox remains in one place.
F:DUP-IMPL:0be687.cause: the old implementation was never removed

F:DARK-GAP:6dd0fe.title: The soft brand colour has no dark value
F:DARK-GAP:6dd0fe.explanation: In dark mode the places that use it keep the light value.

F:TOKEN-TWIN:6dd0fe.title: The brand green is typed by hand in one place
F:TOKEN-TWIN:6dd0fe.explanation: The legacy checkbox types the exact token value; switching to the token changes nothing on screen.

F:PALETTE-GRAYS:6dd0fe.title: Grays come from two systems
F:PALETTE-GRAYS:6dd0fe.explanation: The project's neutral tokens and Tailwind palette grays appear on the same screens.

F:DEAD-TOKEN:339143.title: Some tokens are declared but never used
F:DEAD-TOKEN:339143.explanation: Two chart colours belong to the shadcn base set and stay; the other two can go.

F:INVALID-CLASS:1adaa8.title: A class has no effect
F:INVALID-CLASS:1adaa8.explanation: The card-corner class is defined nowhere, so it does nothing.

F:OFF-SCALE:7561d7.title: One padding is off the grid
F:OFF-SCALE:7561d7.explanation: The green button on Home uses a padding between grid steps.

F:UNREACHED:c212f0.title: A button component is used by no screen
F:UNREACHED:c212f0.explanation: OldButton remains in the code but nothing renders it.

C1.title: Use the radius token where the same value was typed by hand
C1.why: Nothing changes on screen; the value gets a name the next generation will reuse.

C2.title: Use the brand token in the legacy checkbox
C2.why: The typed value equals the token, so nothing changes.

C5.title: Give neighbours in one row the same corners
C5.why: In the toolbar and the settings form the minority follows the majority. Almost invisible.

C8.title: Bring hand-styled buttons back to the base button
C8.why: A visible design decision; check each screen and pick.

limits: Specimens use the fonts installed on this machine.
Catalog-page looks were counted apart and never used as evidence.
